# Quantitative Research & Transpiler Requirements Checklist: QuantLab

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of quantitative, information-theoretic, and transpiler requirements
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Causal Point-in-Time (PIT) & Stationarity Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK001 Are causal Point-in-Time (PIT) invariance tolerances explicitly quantified for Fractional Differentiation and indicator evaluation (`max abs diff < 1e-12`)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK002 Is the Fixed-Width Window Fractional Differentiation weight truncation formula and stationarity acceptance threshold (`ADF p < 0.05`) unambiguously specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are offline and deterministic fallback requirements defined when external market providers (`yfinance`, `ccxt`) are unreachable? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-001, §Edge Cases]

## Dual Neuro-Symbolic Indicator & Pine Script v6 Transpiler Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK004 Are all 5 baseline indicators (`RSI`, `EMA`, `ATR`, `MACD`, `KAMA`) and 3 physics-inspired indicators (`KalmanFilter`, `PhaseSpaceEnergy`, `EntropyFlow`) explicitly enumerated with dual numerical and symbolic AST requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 Is the mapping between symbolic time-series AST primitives (`Lag`, `EMA`, `SMA`, `RMA`, `Stdev`, `Highest`, `Lowest`, `Recurrence`) and TradingView Pine Script v6 (`//@version=6`) constructs documented? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Contracts §2]
- [x] CHK006 Are error handling requirements defined when a non-transpilable or unsupported AST operator is passed to the Pine Script v6 transpiler? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Information-Theoretic, Statistical & DSP Gate Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK007 Are the quantitative pass/fail thresholds explicitly defined for Stationarity (`ADF p < 0.05`), Surrogate Transfer Entropy (`p < 0.05`), Rank IC (`|IC| > 0.02`), and Orthogonality (`VIF < 5.0`)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Are both null hypothesis surrogate generation methods (`iaaft` and `block_shuffle`) specified for Transfer Entropy significance testing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Are boundary conditions defined for constant/zero-variance series and collinear design matrices in Rank IC, RSI, and VIF calculations? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are the DSP diagnostic metrics (Hilbert instantaneous phase lag in radians/bars, Bode response, and 3rd-derivative Jerk energy) clearly specified to define the Pareto frontier? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]

## CLI & 4-Quadrant Diagnostic Dashboard Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK011 Are all 5 CLI subcommands (`fetch`, `indicators`, `evaluate`/`prove`, `transpile`, `dashboard`) and their primary options specified consistently across `spec.md` and `contracts/`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Contracts §1]
- [x] CHK012 Are the visual and interactive contents of all 4 Dashboard Quadrants (Q1 Price/Phase-Space, Q2 Entropy/Surrogates, Q3 IC/Wasserstein/VIF/Bode, Q4 Live SymPy-to-Pine v6 Studio) clearly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
